title: Easy-plane anisotropy of magnetic fluctuations in UTe2
summary: The large directional anisotropy of superconducting UTe2 along the lattice a, b, c directions in magnetic susceptibility, upper critical fields, and Knight shift suggests spin-triplet Cooper pairing. If spin fluctuations bind the Cooper pair, one needs to determine their anisotropy in spin space to characterize the superconducting state. Here we use polarised and unpolarised inelastic neutron scattering (INS) experiments to show that antiferromagnetic (AFM) spin fluctuations at the Y point are highly isotropic within the ac-plane but have no observable magnitude along the b-axis. Our results rule out the assumed Ising anisotropy and constrain the possible pairing channels. AFM exchange is no longer pair forming in the triplet channel and the d vector along b is strongly favoured. We capture the experimental observations within a microscopic framework that encompasses the dual nature of 5f electrons. We include itinerant and localized 5f-moments in a tight-binding model fitted to quantum oscillations data. In congruence with INS, the exchange between localized moments generically consists of a strong FM intra-dimer interaction, maxima close to the Y and T points, mediated by 5p_y and 6d_{3z^2-r^2} orbitals respectively, and magnetically decoupled ab-planes. We find that anisotropy and dimerization of the moments can lead to gapped excitations that, in combination with Landau damping, can produce the observed overdamped response at the Y point. We suggest that enhancement of the response and its observed near-O(2)-symmetry could both be driven by proximity to a quantum critical point where the dimer excitation gap closes and gives place to incommensurate helical order. Analysis of the linearized gap equation for a nearest-neighbour pairing interaction favours the B1u triplet with a dominant d-vector component along b, although the possibility of spin singlet pairing cannot be ruled out.

AI.tldr: 本文用极化/非极化非弹性中子散射研究UTe2的自旋涨落各向异性，发现Y点反铁磁涨落在ac面内高度各向同性、b轴方向无可观测分量，推翻Ising各向异性假设，支持d矢量沿b的三重态配对。
AI.motivation: UTe2在a、b、c方向磁化率、上临界场和Knight位移上的强方向各向异性暗示自旋三重态配对。若自旋涨落是配对机制，则必须确定其在自旋空间的各向异性以刻画超导态。已有工作常假设Ising各向异性，但缺乏直接实验证据。
AI.method: 采用极化和非极化非弹性中子散射（INS）测量Y点反铁磁自旋涨落的自旋空间各向异性。并建立微观理论框架，纳入5f电子的双重性：将巡游与局域5f磁矩放入紧束缚模型，模型参数由量子振荡数据拟合；计算局域矩间交换作用、磁激发与Landau阻尼，并求解线性化能隙方程。
AI.result: Y点反铁磁涨落在ac面内高度各向同性，而沿b轴无可观测幅度，排除Ising各向异性假设。理论交换作用包含强铁磁二聚体内相互作用，在Y点和T点附近出现极大值，分别由5p_y和6d_{3z^2-r^2}轨道中介，ab面间磁退耦。各向异性与二聚化可导致带隙激发，结合Landau阻尼产生Y点观察到的过阻尼响应。线性化能隙方程对最近邻配对相互作用偏好B1u三重态，d矢量主要沿b方向；但自旋单态配对不能排除。
AI.conclusion: UTe2中自旋涨落并非Ising型各向异性，而是ac面内各向同性、b轴无分量，从而约束配对通道：三重态下反铁磁交换不再支持配对，d矢量沿b最受青睐。响应增强与近O(2)对称性可能源自接近量子临界点，此时二聚激发能隙闭合并转为非公度螺旋磁序。最近邻配对作用下B1u三重态最优，但自旋单态仍有可能。

title: Fermion bag study of the two-dimensional Majorana-Hubbard model at finite hopping
summary: The two-dimensional Majorana-Hubbard model on the $π$-flux lattice involves the most local interaction possible for a lattice with one relativistic Majorana fermion per site. It is predicted to host a Majorana semimetal, dimerized phases, and quantum-critical points with an emergent $U(1)$ symmetry. Nonperturbative lattice calculations for this model remain a major open challenge, thus far limited to zero hopping. We present quantum Monte Carlo simulations of the model at finite hopping using Hamiltonian fermion bags, which are based on a continuous-time expansion with Boltzmann weights that are Pfaffians of a matrix with dimension set by the expansion order, and which give the sign of the weight. Sign problem severity is related to the location of zero modes in the free hopping matrix, and for couplings $g\lesssim 0.7$ and $β=L/4$ it is fully removed for lattices up to at least $256$ sites. The interaction strength $g>0$ enhances the $U(1)$-charged dimerization doublet and suppresses the neutral channel, as the renormalization group predicts. Increasing the interactions also restores $U(1)$ symmetry in the component of the dimerization correlator that is even under bond orientation exchange, but not its odd component. There is a persistent anisotropy in the odd component with the symmetry of a lattice nematic. The data is consistent with a gapless semimetal throughout the sign-problem-minimal window.

AI.tldr: 本文用基于哈密顿量费米子袋（Pfaffian权重）的量子蒙特卡洛方法，首次对有限跃迁的π-通量格点Majorana-Hubbard模型进行非微扰模拟，在可去除符号问题的参数窗口内研究其相图与对称性。
AI.motivation: 该模型预言存在Majorana半金属、二聚化相及涌现U(1)对称性的量子临界点，但此前的非微扰格点计算受限于零跃迁情形，有限跃迁下的模拟仍是重大挑战。
AI.method: 采用哈密顿量费米子袋（Hamiltonian fermion bags）方法，基于连续时间展开，权重为矩阵Pfaffian（矩阵维度由展开阶决定）并给出权重符号；分析符号问题严重性与自由跃迁矩阵零模位置的关系。
AI.result: 对g≲0.7、β=L/4，符号问题在至少256格点内被完全消除。g>0增强U(1)带电二聚化二重态并抑制中性通道，符合重整化群预言；相互作用恢复了二聚化关联中键取向交换偶分量的U(1)对称性，但奇分量仍存在类似晶格向列的持续各向异性。数据在符号问题最小的窗口内与无能隙半金属一致。
AI.conclusion: 该工作实现了有限跃迁下Majorana-Hubbard模型的无符号问题量子蒙特卡洛模拟，验证了RG关于相互作用增强带电二聚化的预言，发现偶分量U(1)对称性恢复而奇分量各向异性持续，整体数据支持无能隙半金属相。

title: Matrix Density Waves and Fractionally Charged Point Defects in Flavor Weyl Semimetals
summary: A conventional interaction-driven Weyl density wave is a complex scalar and supports vortex lines, but no topologically stable point defects. We show that two Weyl flavors do not merely duplicate this order. Starting from the matrix-valued internode coherence, a local flavor-symmetric repulsion selects a traceless adjoint condensate within the density-wave sector, while the fermionic ground-state energy locks its complex components into the collinear form $\mathbfΔ=Φ_0\mathbf{n} e^{iθ}$. The resulting order-parameter manifold, $(S^2\times S^1)/\mathbb Z_2$, supports both unit hedgehogs and half-quantum Alice strings of the same electronic mass that gaps the Weyl fermions. An elementary hedgehog binds a single normalizable zero mode whose empty and occupied sectors carry charges $-e/2$ and $+e/2$ at neutrality. An elementary Alice string carries a single chiral electronic mode despite its $π$ phase winding, and transporting a hedgehog around it reverses the hedgehog winding, $N\rightarrow-N$. Flavor therefore converts spontaneous translation breaking into a route to point-defect fractionalization and intertwines the point- and line-defect sectors of an interaction-generated electronic mass.

AI.tldr: 双味Weyl密度波序参量为无迹伴随凝聚，形成(S²×S¹)/Z₂流形，支持刺猬点和半量子Alice弦缺陷，实现点缺陷分数化与点-线缺陷纠缠。
AI.motivation: 传统相互作用驱动的Weyl密度波是复标量序，只有涡线而无拓扑稳定的点缺陷。作者探究引入第二个Weyl味的"味道自由度"是否能超越简单复制，产生新的拓扑缺陷结构。
AI.method: 从矩阵值节点间相干出发，引入局部味道对称排斥，在密度波扇区选出无迹伴随凝聚；利用费米子基态能将复分量锁定为共线形式 Δ=Φ₀n e^{iθ}，分析所得序参量流形及其拓扑缺陷。
AI.result: 序参量流形(S²×S¹)/Z₂同时支持单位刺猬和半量子Alice弦，二者对应同一电子质量。单个刺猬束缚一个可归一化零模，中性时其空/占据态电荷为-e/2与+e/2；单条Alice弦载有单个手性电子模；沿弦环绕刺猬使缠绕数反转N→-N。
AI.conclusion: 味道自由度将自发平移破缺转化为点缺陷分数化的途径，并交织了相互作用生成电子质量的点缺陷与线缺陷扇区。

title: Robust Strange Metallicity across Attractive and Repulsive Hubbard Models
summary: Using determinant quantum Monte Carlo simulations, we compare charge transport in the two-dimensional attractive and repulsive Hubbard models at strong coupling, $|U|/t=6$. Although the interaction with opposite signs generates qualitatively different low-energy spin, charge, and pairing correlations, both exhibit approximately linear-in-temperature resistivity over a broad intermediate- and high-temperature regime. At asymptotically high temperature this common behavior follows from the moment expansion of the conductivity, whose leading contribution is even in $U$. More strikingly, the similarity persists to temperatures well below $|U|$, where strong interaction-dependent correlations have already developed, and also irrespective of whether resistivity crosses the MIR limit. Using the Nernst--Einstein relation, we find that the common linear-in-temperature resistivity is primarily associated with an approximately Curie-like charge compressibility and weakly temperature-dependent diffusivity. The two models separate only at lower temperatures, where the attractive model develops a pronounced feature in the charge diffusivity correlated with signatures of pair formation. These results show that linear-in-temperature incoherent transport in the Hubbard model can be remarkably insensitive to the microscopic nature of the low-energy correlations. Our results suggest that transport in the incoherent regime appears insensitive to what the system will ultimately become at low temperature; the distinction between competing low-energy states becomes visible only when their characteristic correlations acquire sufficiently long spatial or temporal coherence.

AI.tldr: 用DQMC比较二维吸引与排斥Hubbard模型在强耦合下的电荷输运，发现二者虽低温关联截然不同，却都呈现近似线性电阻率，且该行为在低温下仍持续，仅更低温度才分离。
AI.motivation: 探讨线性温度电阻率是否依赖于微观低能关联的具体性质；吸引与排斥Hubbard模型产生截然不同的自旋、电荷与配对关联，是比较该问题的理想平台。
AI.method: 采用行列式量子蒙特卡洛（DQMC）模拟，在|U|/t=6强耦合下对比吸引和排斥Hubbard模型的电荷输运；结合电导率的矩展开分析高温行为，并用Nernst–Einstein关系将电阻率分解为电荷压缩率与扩散率。
AI.result: 两模型在宽广中高温区间均呈近似线性电阻率；高温极限下该共性源于电导率矩展开中主项的U偶次性；线性电阻率主要对应近似居里型电荷压缩率和弱温度依赖扩散率。二者仅在更低温度分离，吸引模型在电荷扩散率上出现与配对形成相关的显著特征。相似性在低于|U|及跨越MIR极限时依然成立。
AI.conclusion: Hubbard模型中的线性温度非相干输运对低能关联的微观性质极不敏感。非相干区的输运似乎不反映系统低温最终会形成何种状态；只有竞争性低能态的特征关联具有足够长的时间或空间相干性时，区分才会显现。

title: Anisotropic upper critical field in the van der Waals superconducting quasicrystal (Ta$_{0.7}$Nb$_{0.3}$)$_{1.6}$Te
summary: We investigated the upper critical field of a large single grain of the Nb-substituted van der Waals layered quasicrystal (Ta$_{0.7}$Nb$_{0.3}$)$_{1.6}$Te. The sample exhibits a sharp superconducting transition at $T_{\mathrm{c}}$ = 1.35 K, the highest value reported to date among quasicrystal superconductors. The angular dependence of the critical field exhibits a pronounced criterion dependence: the field determined using the 10% $R_{\mathrm{N}}$ ($R_{\mathrm{N}}$: normal-state resistance) criterion is well described by the anisotropic Ginzburg-Landau model, whereas those determined using the 65% and 90% $R_{\mathrm{N}}$ criteria exhibit Tinkham-like angular dependence characteristic of two-dimensional superconductivity. The high-field part of the resistive transition is well described by a surface-superconductivity model and exhibits a pronounced excitation-current dependence for magnetic fields close to the $ab$ plane, supporting the presence of surface superconductivity on the quasiperiodic $ab$-plane surfaces. The bulk $H_{\mathrm{c2}}$ is strongly anisotropic, with the in-plane $H_{\mathrm{c2}}$ exceeding the weak-coupling Pauli limit by a factor of approximately 2.5. For both field orientations, $H_{\mathrm{c2}}(T)$ deviates upward from the conventional dirty-limit Werthamer-Helfand-Hohenberg prediction at low temperatures. A phenomenologically modified Ginzburg-Landau-Abrikosov-Gorkov model incorporating a spatial distribution of the electronic diffusivity substantially improves the description of $H_{\mathrm{c2}}(T)$, suggesting that spatial variations in electronic transport properties may contribute to its anomalous temperature dependence.

AI.tldr: 研究了Nb替代的范德华层状准晶(Ta0.7Nb0.3)1.6Te大单晶的上临界场，Tc达1.35 K为准晶超导体最高，发现表面超导与强各向异性，且Hc2偏离脏极限WHH预言。
AI.motivation: 探索准晶超导体的上临界场行为及其与层状结构、电子输运空间不均匀性的关系，尤其是Nb替代能否提升Tc并揭示新颖的超导维度特征。
AI.method: 测量大单晶的电阻-温度转变、上临界场的角度依赖（采用10%、65%、90% RN判据），并用各向异性Ginzburg-Landau模型、Tinkham二维模型、表面超导模型及引入电子扩散率空间分布的修正Ginzburg-Landau-Abrikosov-Gorkov模型进行拟合分析。
AI.result: Tc=1.35 K为该类准晶最高；10%判据符合各向异性GL模型，65%和90%判据呈Tinkham二维行为；近ab面高场区符合表面超导模型且有激发电流依赖；体Hc2强各向异性，面内值超弱耦合Pauli极限约2.5倍，低温下上翘偏离脏极限WHH预言，修正GLAG模型显著改善拟合。
AI.conclusion: 该准晶超导体表现出二维表面超导与强各向异性体超导，其异常Hc2(T)可用电子扩散率空间分布解释，暗示电子输运空间不均匀性是准晶超导的关键因素。

title: Interlayer-correlated fractional quantum Hall state in a trilayer electron system
summary: In multilayer quantum Hall systems, when the layer separation is sufficiently small, the interplay between intralayer and interlayer Coulomb interactions can lead to exotic, multi-component, many-body states. A particular example is the even-denominator fractional quantum Hall state (FQHS) at total filling factor $ν=1/2$ in bilayer systems with negligible interlayer tunneling. This state can be understood as a generalized Laughlin state described by the Halperin-Laughlin $Ψ_{331}$ wavefunction. While such correlated states have been extensively explored in bilayers, little is known about their counterparts in systems with more than two layers. Here, we investigate a trilayer two-dimensional electron system confined to ultrahigh-quality GaAs triple quantum wells. We observe an exotic FQHS at total filling factor $ν=5/7$, evinced by a deep longitudinal resistance minimum and a quantized Hall plateau, when the side layers have a density larger than the middle layer and $d/l_B \simeq 2.2$ ($d$ is the interlayer distance and $l_B$ the magnetic length). This state is naturally interpreted as the long-predicted trilayer, generalized Laughlin ($Ψ_{33311}$) state, characterized by $ν=1/3$-like intralayer correlation within each layer and $ν=1$-like interlayer correlation between neighboring layers. Our observation establishes a new member of the Halperin-Laughlin many-body states that extends interlayer coherence to three coupled layers.

AI.tldr: 在GaAs三量子阱中观测到总填充因子ν=5/7的奇异分数量子霍尔态，被解释为预言的三层级叠Laughlin (Ψ33311) 态。
AI.motivation: 多层量子霍尔体系中，层间与层内库仑相互作用可导致奇特多组分多体态。双层中已知ν=1/2的Ψ331态，但多于两层的对应态尚不清楚，本文探索三层体系。
AI.method: 在超高迁移率GaAs三量子阱限制的三层二维电子系中，通过输运测量，在侧层密度大于中间层且d/l_B≈2.2条件下寻找分数量子霍尔态。
AI.result: 观测到总填充因子ν=5/7的奇异FQHS，表现为深纵向电阻极小和量子化霍尔平台。
AI.conclusion: 该态被自然解释为长期预言的三层级叠广义Laughlin (Ψ33311) 态，具有层内ν=1/3型、相邻层间ν=1型关联，确立了将层间相干扩展到三个耦合层的新型Halperin-Laughlin态。

title: First-Principles Nonadiabatic Dynamics via the Multi-Orbital Anderson-Newns Model
summary: We develop a first-principles theory for nonadiabatic surface dynamics, providing a fit-free connection between density functional theory (DFT) calculations and the effective multi-orbital Anderson-Newns (AN) theory. Our theory contains two main advances. First, we outline the multi-orbital AN theory with orbital overlap and derive closed-form expressions for the hybridization energy, electronic dynamics, and electronic friction. Second, we describe a procedure to map the DFT Hamiltonian into the effective AN Hamiltonian with nuclear-position dependence. We obtain the electronic part of the AN Hamiltonian solely from the adsorbate-projected density-of-states matrix. We then define the bare nuclear potential as the difference between the total energy and the hybridization energy. The theory is applied to H and CO on the Cu surface, where widely used assumptions about the hybridization function, including the wide-band limit, semi-elliptical forms, and separability in energy and nuclear coordinate, are found to fail, and the single-orbital description breaks down qualitatively for CO. We expect this work to be broadly useful for first-principles modeling of coupled nuclear-electronic dynamics and chemical reactions at metallic surfaces.

AI.tldr: 本文建立了非绝热表面动力学的第一性原理理论，实现DFT计算与多轨道Anderson-Newns理论之间的无需拟合连接。
AI.motivation: 需要一种将DFT与有效Anderson-Newns理论无拟合衔接的方法，用于金属表面耦合的核-电子动力学与化学反应的第一性原理建模，同时克服常用近似（宽波段极限、半椭圆形式、能量与核坐标可分离、单轨道描述）的局限。
AI.method: 提出含轨道重叠的多轨道Anderson-Newns理论，推导杂化能、电子动力学与电子摩擦的闭式表达；并给出将DFT哈密顿量映射为随核位置变化的有效AN哈密顿量的方法：仅从吸附物投影态密度矩阵获得AN的电子部分，将裸核势定义为总能量与杂化能之差。
AI.result: 将理论应用于Cu表面的H和CO。发现常用杂化函数假设（宽波段极限、半椭圆形式、能量与核坐标可分离）失效；对CO而言单轨道描述在定性上失效。
AI.conclusion: 该工作预期可广泛用于金属表面耦合核-电子动力学与化学反应的第一性原理建模。

title: Electrothermal Compact Drift Model of TiO$_2$ Memristors: Verilog-A Implementation and Dimensionless Regime Mapping
summary: Compact models of titanium-dioxide memristors used in circuit simulation commonly follow the drift formulation of Strukov \textit{et al.} and assume a constant ionic mobility, although oxygen-vacancy migration is thermally activated and Joule self-heating is unavoidable. We present ATDM (Arrhenius Thermally Activated Drift Model), a minimal electrothermal compact model that couples the drift equation to a lumped heat balance through an Arrhenius mobility. It adds one thermal state while preserving the electrical state variable, the relation $v=iR(x)$, and the isothermal limit. The model is implemented in \textsc{Verilog-A}, compiled with OpenVAF, and simulated as a device in \texttt{ngspice}, where it reproduces an independent reference implementation within $0.009\,\%$ of the peak voltage and recovers the isothermal excursion at zero activation energy. A dimensionless formulation introduces a thermal lag $\varepsilon$ and an effective switching number $Θ$. Across $2.5\times10^{5}$ simulations, $Θ$ orders the state-variable excursion over the tested quasi-static domain with a robust relative scatter of $4\,\%$ and no fitted constant, and the $(\varepsilon,Θ)$ regime map quantifies when the quasi-static thermal reduction remains valid. Under current drive, the stroboscopic map of the reduced model is proved to be strictly increasing, which excludes period-doubling and chaos in that reduction. Within the sampled ranges, a variance-based sensitivity analysis identifies the effective thermal resistance as a first-order contributor to self-heating, while separate capacitance sweeps show a weak influence of the thermal capacitance in the quasi-static regime. The results characterize the specified model with representative, uncalibrated parameters.

AI.tldr: 提出ATDM紧凑电热模型，将漂移方程与集总热平衡通过Arrhenius迁移率耦合，用Verilog-A实现并在ngspice验证。
AI.motivation: 现有TiO2忆阻器紧凑模型多沿用Strukov漂移公式并假设迁移率恒定，但氧空位迁移是热激活的且焦耳自热不可避免，故需要能反映热效应的最小电热模型。
AI.method: 在保持电学状态变量、v=iR(x)关系和等温极限的前提下，引入Arrhenius迁移率与一个热状态变量，构建最小电热漂移模型；以Verilog-A实现、OpenVAF编译、ngspice仿真；引入无量纲热滞后ε和有效开关数Θ，并结合频闪映射与基于方差的敏感性分析。
AI.result: 与独立参考实现峰值电压误差在0.009%内，零激活能时回到等温情形；2.5×10^5次仿真中Θ以4%相对散布无拟合常数地排序状态量偏移；给出(ε,Θ)区间图；证明电流驱动下频闪映射严格单调，排除周期倍化与混沌；敏感性分析显示有效热阻是一阶主因，热容在准静态区影响微弱。
AI.conclusion: ATDM以最少状态量刻画TiO2忆阻器热激活漂移与自热，参数未标定即具代表性，可为电路仿真提供兼顾精度与热效应的紧凑模型。

title: Exact Collision Vertex for Stress and Heat Flux
summary: For the hard-sphere Boltzmann equation, we derive an exact nonlinear generating vertex for collisional stress and heat-flux production. The complete two-input Hermite hierarchy for stress resums to a universal traceless tensor times one scalar radial law, while the heat-flux vertex follows from the same law by an exact contraction. Taylor differentiation yields universal bilinear collision tensors with exact stress and heat-flux gradings, without a finite moment closure. DSMC tests, including wall-driven flows and a bimodal Mach-5 shock, recover independently sampled Boltzmann productions and the predicted convergence, while the converged production is independent of the thermal Gaussian foot used for its Hermite representation.

AI.tldr: 本文为硬球Boltzmann方程推导了碰撞应力与热流的精确非线性生成顶点，给出无需有限矩封闭的通用双线性碰撞张量，并用DSMC验证。
AI.motivation: 碰撞产生的应力与热流通常依赖有限矩封闭近似，缺乏精确、通用的非线性生成顶点描述。
AI.method: 对硬球Boltzmann方程推导精确非线性生成顶点；构建双输入Hermite层级，将应力重求和为无迹张量乘以标量径向律，热流顶点由同一律精确收缩得到；用Taylor微分获得通用双线性碰撞张量并赋予精确的应力与热流分级，无需有限矩封闭。
AI.result: DSMC测试（壁驱动流动与双峰Mach-5激波）复现了独立采样的Boltzmann产生项与预测的收敛性；收敛产生项与用于Hermite表示的热高斯基无关。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为碰撞应力与热流生成提供了精确、封闭无关的通用表示，并通过DSMC验证其正确性与对表示基的独立性。

title: Optimal Bias Potentials via Ergodic Optimal Control and Generator Learning
summary: We investigate the computation of optimal bias potentials for accelerating transitions between metastable states and for computation of equilibrium properties in molecular dynamics simulations. We formulate optimal biasing as an ergodic optimal control problem (OCP), which can be recast as a linear eigenvalue problem for the infinitesimal generator of the unbiased dynamics. We demonstrate that data-driven learning methods for the generator enable reliable solution of the OCP, computation of biasing potentials, extraction of equilibrium properties, and acceleration of state transitions. We also explore the relation of the control problem to coarse grained representations and learning of coarse grained dynamics.

AI.tldr: 本文将最优偏置势的构造建模为遍历最优控制问题（OCP），可转化为无偏动力学生成元的线性特征值问题，并用数据驱动的生成元学习方法求解，实现偏置势计算、平衡态性质提取及状态跃迁加速。
AI.motivation: 分子动力学中亚稳态间跃迁缓慢、平衡态采样效率低，需要设计最优偏置势来加速过渡并获取平衡性质，而传统方法缺乏系统的最优性框架。
AI.method: 将最优偏置问题表述为遍历最优控制问题，重新表述为无偏动力学无穷小生成元的线性特征值问题；采用数据驱动的生成元学习方法来求解该OCP，并探讨控制问题与粗粒化表示及粗粒化动力学学习的关系。
AI.result: 数据驱动的生成元学习方法能够可靠求解OCP，计算偏置势，提取平衡态性质，并加速状态间的跃迁；同时揭示了控制问题与粗粒化动力学之间的联系。
AI.conclusion: 将偏置问题纳入最优控制框架并借助生成元学习，为分子动力学中的增强采样与平衡态计算提供了一种原理性且数据驱动的方法。

title: Spin Configurations of Anyonic excitations in Moiré Fractional Chern Insulators
summary: We have examined the nature of elementary excitations in particular, their spin polarization, in recently discovered zero-field fractional Chern insulator in twisted bilayer MoTe$_2$. We have found that the finite-size bilayer system, in close proximity to a planar parabolic quantum dot containing a single electron (or a hole), forms an incompressible spin-unpolarized fractional Chern insulator at 1/3 filling factor. The corresponding energy gap is found to be large and weakly dependent on the separation between the quantum dot and the bilayer. We predict that in this fractional Chern insulator coupled to a quantum dot, spin-unpolarized quasiparticles and quasiholes are expected to appear as low-energy elementary excitations. The charge density results indicate that, for the spin-unpolarized quasiparticles, the positive charge is strongly localized near the negatively charged QD within the spin-flipped component, whereas for the spin-polarized quasiparticles, such localization is much less pronounced.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究了扭转双层MoTe₂中零场分数量子陈绝缘体的元激发性质，特别是自旋极化，发现其与量子点耦合时形成自旋非极化的FCI。
AI.motivation: 探究近期发现的零场分数量子陈绝缘体中元激发的本质，尤其是其自旋极化特性，以理解该体系的低能激发态。
AI.method: 将有限尺寸双层系统放置在靠近含单个电子（或空穴）的平面抛物量子点附近，研究其在1/3填充因子下的行为，并分析能隙及电荷密度分布。
AI.result: 系统形成不可压缩的自旋非极化分数量子陈绝缘体；能隙较大且对量子点与双层间距依赖较弱；预期出现自旋非极化的准粒子和准空穴作为低能元激发。电荷密度显示，自旋非极化准粒子的正电荷在自旋翻转分量中强烈局域于带负电量子点附近，而自旋极化准粒子则局域化不明显。
AI.conclusion: 在耦合量子点的分数量子陈绝缘体中，低能元激发为自旋非极化的准粒子和准空穴，且其局域化行为与自旋极化状态显著不同。

title: Field-induced incipient spin-density phase stabilized inside the nematic phase of FeSe$_{1-x}$S$_x$
summary: Spin-density wave (SDW) order and superconductivity frequently compete and coexist in unconventional superconductors, where spin fluctuations often mediate superconducting pairing. In iron-chalcogenide superconductors, FeSe$_{1-x}$S$_x$, SDW order has only been detected under applied pressure, while both spin and nematic fluctuations are involved in determining their rich superconducting phase diagrams. Here, we report evidence for an incipient SDW phase, within the nematic state of FeSe$_{1-x}$S$_x$, revealed in magnetic fields up to 68~T. Once superconductivity is quenched, we observe sharp upturns in longitudinal resistivity accompanied by anomalies in tunnel diode oscillator frequency response and torque anisotropy, consistent with a field-induced electronic order. Dominant low-frequency quantum oscillations reveal a small reconstructed Fermi surface, consistent with a field-induced SDW order. Direct experimental comparisons with a pressure-tuned nematic, analogue, FeSe$_{0.96}$S$_{0.04}$, demonstrate that SDW phases are stabilized within the nematic phase of FeSe$_{1-x}$S$_x$ via both chemical substitution and applied pressure. These findings reveal that by weakening nematicity, the SDW orders are stabilised, which promotes the dominant superconducting pairing mechanism in iron chalcogenides.

AI.tldr: 在FeSe$_{1-x}$S$_x$中，通过高达68 T磁场淬灭超导后，发现了处于向列态内的萌发自旋密度波（SDW）相，表明通过弱化向列性可稳定SDW序。
AI.motivation: 铁基硫族超导体FeSe$_{1-x}$S$_x$中SDW序此前仅在加压下被观测，其自旋与向列涨落共同决定复杂超导相图，SDW与超导的关系尚不清楚。
AI.method: 在高达68 T的磁场下测量FeSe$_{1-x}$S$_x$的纵向电阻率、隧道二极管振荡器频率响应、扭矩各向异性及量子振荡，并与压力调控的向列类比物FeSe$_{0.96}$S$_{0.04}$进行对比。
AI.result: 超导被淬灭后，电阻率出现陡峭上翘，伴随磁响应和扭矩各向异性异常；主导的低频量子振荡揭示出小的重构费米面，与场诱导SDW序一致。化学替代与加压均可在向列相内稳定SDW相。
AI.conclusion: 弱化向列性可稳定SDW序，进而促进铁硫族超导体中主导的超导配对机制。

title: Electronic Effects of a Twisted Graphene Catenoid Bridge
summary: The interplay between non-trivial background geometries and quantum dynamics has emerged as a powerful tool to tailor the electronic properties of 2D materials. In this work, we investigate the effective quantum dynamics of massless Dirac fermions confined to a twisted graphene structure called a catenoid bridge, which connects two single-layer sheets. By adopting a continuum approach, where the electron dynamics is governed by a purely covariant curved Dirac equation, we obtain the effective Hamiltonian containing both curvature and twist interactions. We found that the torsion modifies the electronic states by producing a geometric phase on the wave function. In addition, the twist also deforms the surface geometry, which leads to a new geometric term in the effective Hamiltonian. This twist potential enhances the barrier around the catenoid throat, which increases the suppression of the inter-layer transmission coefficient. Like the spin-curvature interaction, the spin-twist term has a chiral dependence which is invariant under a combined parity and spin flip transformation. As a result, the electronic states can be restricted to the upper or lower layer. These findings provide valuable insights into how mechanical deformations can be harnessed to control quantum transport in graphene-based wormhole architectures.

AI.tldr: 研究无质量狄拉克费米子在"悬链桥"(catenoid bridge)扭曲石墨烯结构中的有效量子动力学,揭示曲率与扭曲如何共同调控电子态与层间输运。
AI.motivation: 利用非平凡背景几何与量子动力学的相互作用来裁剪二维材料电子性质,尤其是连接两层单层石墨烯的扭曲结构(类虫洞)中几何效应尚待深入理解。
AI.method: 采用连续介质方法,以纯协变曲率狄拉克方程描述电子动力学,推导包含曲率与扭曲相互作用的有效哈密顿量。
AI.result: 挠率通过波函数上产生几何相位改变电子态;扭曲使表面几何形变,产生新的几何项(扭曲势),增强悬链喉部势垒并抑制层间透射系数。自旋-扭曲项具有手性依赖,在宇称与自旋翻转联合变换下不变,可将电子态限制在上层或下层。
AI.conclusion: 揭示了机械形变可用于控制石墨烯类虫洞结构中的量子输运,为基于几何的电子调控提供新思路。

title: Uncertainty prediction in composite quantum chemistry approaches
summary: In this work, we consider the problem of uncertainty estimation of the results obtained through theoretical calculations using a composite quantum chemistry scheme. Each component of the composite scheme carries its own individual uncertainty, originating principally from a finite size of the basis set used in the calculations. Of practical interest is the total uncertainty, i.e. the uncertainty of the sum of all components. We first show that the conventional error propagation rules that treat each component as a statistically uncorrelated variable are not well-justified in practice. To remedy this, we propose a method of estimating the total uncertainty of the composite scheme which does not rely on the assumption that the components are independent. It is formulated as a series of random walks with different starting values that represent the uncertainty of each component of the composite scheme. This method is first applied to two example composite schemes for the water dimer and the nitrogen molecule that illustrate its most salient features and allow for a deeper analysis. Next, the method is tested for a larger set of interaction energies from the S66 dataset for which trustworthy reference data are available and the error can be assessed unambiguously. It is shown that the method provides reliable and reasonably tight uncertainty estimates at an arbitrary predefined confidence level required in a given application. While the focus of the paper is on composite schemes, we believe that the general idea can be useful more broadly in computational chemistry and physics.

AI.tldr: 提出一种不依赖组分独立性假设的复合量子化学方案总不确定度估计方法，基于不同起始值的随机游走模型。
AI.motivation: 复合量子化学方案各组分各自带有不确定度（主要来自有限基组），实际关心的是总量不确定度。但传统误差传播规则假设各组分统计不相关，这一假设在实践上缺乏依据。
AI.method: 提出将总量不确定度估计表述为一系列具有不同起始值的随机游走，起始值代表各组分的不确定度，从而无需假设组分独立。先在两个示例方案（水二聚体和氮分子）上验证，再在S66数据集的大规模相互作用能上测试。
AI.result: 传统不相关假设不合理；所提方法在S66数据集上能给出可靠且相对紧致的不确定度估计，并可在任意预定义置信水平下工作。
AI.conclusion: 该方法提供了不依赖独立性假设的可靠不确定度估计，虽聚焦复合方案，但其一般思想可更广泛地应用于计算化学与物理领域。

title: Suppressed Defect Emission and Enhanced Blue Luminescence of Zn-Doped CuBr Quantum Dots synthesized in Room-Temperature Synthesis
summary: Deep-blue-emitting CuBr quantum dots (QDs) hold promise as nontoxic and heavy-metal-free optoelectronic materials, yet their efficiency is limited by intrinsic defects. We report Zn doping as an effective strategy to mitigate defect-mediated recombination in CuBr QDs synthesized via an eco-friendly supersaturated recrystallization method under ambient conditions. XRD shows lattice contraction, Rietveld refinement confirms substitutional doping, and XPS verifies Cu$^+$/ Zn$^{2+}$ states without secondary phases. HR-TEM analysis reveals uniform 3.46 $\pm$ 0.12 nm Zn:CuBr QDs with reduced bandgap, after doping, indicating weaker quantum confinement. The dominant emission peaks appear at 406 nm ($Z_f$) and 431 nm ($Z_{1,2}$) under 365 nm excitation. Narrows defect FWHM, elevated band-edge emission, and extends carrier lifetimes, achieving 96.4 \% color purity with CIE coordinates (0.1520, 0.0395). These findings demonstrate that Zn doping is a simple, scalable, and environmentally benign strategy for engineering efficient blue-emitting CuBr QDs.

AI.tldr: 通过Zn掺杂抑制CuBr量子点缺陷复合，实现高纯度深蓝发光。
AI.motivation: CuBr量子点是无毒、无重金属的深蓝发光材料，但本征缺陷限制其效率。
AI.method: 采用环保的过饱和重结晶法在常温下合成Zn:CuBr量子点；通过XRD、Rietveld精修、XPS、HR-TEM及发光/寿命表征分析结构与光学性质。
AI.result: XRD显示晶格收缩，Rietveld确认替位掺杂，XPS验证Cu+/Zn2+价态无杂相；得到3.46±0.12 nm均匀量子点并带隙减小（量子限域减弱）；406 nm与431 nm为主发光峰，缺陷FWHM变窄、带边发光增强、载流子寿命延长，色纯度96.4%，CIE(0.1520,0.0395)。
AI.conclusion: Zn掺杂是一种简单、可规模化且环境友好的策略，可用于工程化高效蓝光CuBr量子点。

title: Analytical Solution of the Nonlinear Boltzmann Equation For Multicomponent Systems
summary: We present exact analytical solutions to the nonlinear relativistic Boltzmann equation for homogeneous, isotropic massless multi-component systems with non-isotropic scattering cross sections. For a two-component system, we identify three distinct classes of exact solutions, each corresponding to specific constraints among initial energy densities, particle number densities, and scattering cross sections. These solutions comprise the equilibrium state and two novel classes: a hybrid structure featuring a non-equilibrium Maxwell-Juttner distribution coupled with a nontrivial distribution; the former is unprecedented in kinetic theory, while the latter refers to nontrivial dynamics shared by both species, which is novel in the relativistic context.

AI.tldr: 本文给出了均匀、各向同性无质量多组分系统中非线性相对论玻尔兹曼方程的精确解析解，用于非各向同性散射截面。
AI.motivation: 相对论玻尔兹曼方程在非各向同性散射、多组分情形下缺乏精确解析解，作者希望填补这一空白。
AI.method: 对均匀、各向同性、无质量多组分系统求解非线性相对论玻尔兹曼方程，采用非各向同性散射截面，并针对两组分系统进行分类分析。
AI.result: 对两组分系统识别出三类精确解，分别对应初始能量密度、粒子数密度和散射截面之间的特定约束；包括平衡态，以及两类新解：非平衡Maxwell-Juttner分布与非常规分布耦合的混合结构，以及两物种共享的非常规动力学。
AI.conclusion: 该工作首次在动理学理论中发现这类混合结构，并在相对论语境下提出两物种共享的非常规动力学，拓展了相对论玻尔兹曼方程的精确解。

title: Optimal limits on weak integrability breaking and protected thermal memory near qutrit exchange
summary: Although integrability does not universally require a continuous one-site symmetry, we rigorously prove that every jointly analytic, regular Yang-Baxter deformation of the qutrit exchange interaction necessarily retains a nontrivial, analytically varying one-site charge. Breaking this local symmetry imposes a fundamental physical constraint on approximate conservation, governed by the optimal uniform bound $δ^3 \le C\varepsilon$ that explicitly relates the minimal one-site symmetry defect $δ$ to the local current-conservation residual $\varepsilon$. While breaking all one-site charges strictly forbids an exact integrable completion, an optimally compensated nearest-neighbor interaction saturates this cubic limit and anomalously extends the guaranteed infinite-temperature energy-current correlation window to order $|λ|^{-3}$ in the perturbation strength $λ$. Furthermore, we reveal a fundamental resonance obstruction for intrinsic conversion perturbations that strictly prevents any exact first-order repair of a broken one-site charge on any finite ring. Nevertheless, we demonstrate that the complete eight-dimensional charge memory matrix remains thermodynamically protected and approaches the identity for timescales $t=o(|λ|^{-3/2})$, a robust feature of the full infinite-temperature dynamics when the thermodynamic limit is taken before weak coupling.

AI.tldr: 该文用严格证明表明，qutrit交换相互作用的任意联合解析、正则Yang-Baxter形变必保留非平凡且解析变化的一子格局域荷。
AI.motivation: 探究可积性是否普遍需要连续单点对称性，并量化破坏局域荷后对近似守恒与可积完成的基本物理限制。
AI.method: 对qutrit交换相互作用的联合解析、正则Yang-Baxter形变进行严格数学证明，并分析最优一致界δ³≤Cε及共振障碍。
AI.result: 证明任何此类形变必保留一子格荷；给出对称性缺陷δ与局域流守恒残差ε的最优立方界；最优补偿近邻相互作用可达到该极限并将无限温能量流关联窗口扩展至|λ|⁻³；发现内在转换微扰存在共振障碍，无法在有限环上一阶精确修复；八维荷记忆矩阵受热力学保护，在t=o(|λ|⁻³/²)内趋近单位阵。
AI.conclusion: 一子格对称性在解析Yang-Baxter形变下具有刚性；破坏局域荷会施加基本物理约束，但完整荷记忆在热力学极限下仍受保护。

title: Exact Equivariance from Ordinary Neural Networks for Lattice Many-Body Dynamics
summary: Large-scale simulations of correlated electron systems require repeated evaluations of the electronic forces and transition energies driving collective dynamics. Machine-learning surrogates alleviate this bottleneck, but incorporating symmetry often involves carefully designed descriptors or specialized network architectures. We show that ordinary multilayer perceptrons equipped with finite-group averaging provide exactly equivariant surrogates directly from microscopic configurations. The construction separates symmetry enforcement from the internal network architecture and applies to both discrete and continuous lattice degrees of freedom. In the Falicov--Kimball model, it predicts directional hopping free-energy differences; in the Holstein model, its invariant limit generates conservative lattice forces. Benchmarks against exact diagonalization establish microscopic accuracy and agreement of dynamical correlations, while large-scale simulations recover multiscale charge ordering and charge-density-wave coarsening. These results demonstrate an accessible, reusable route to symmetry-preserving many-body dynamics for systems with finite lattice point groups.

AI.tldr: 提出用有限群平均+普通MLP实现精确等变代理模型，直接从微观构型预测电子力与跃迁能，无需专用描述符或网络架构。
AI.motivation: 大规模关联电子体系模拟需反复计算电子力与跃迁能，成为瓶颈；现有机器学习代理引入对称性时常需精心设计描述符或专用网络架构，通用性差。
AI.method: 对普通多层感知机施加有限群平均，使对称性强制与网络内部架构解耦，构造精确等变代理；适用于离散和连续晶格自由度。
AI.result: 在Falicov-Kimball模型中预测方向性跃迁自由能差；在Holstein模型中其不变极限生成保守晶格力。与精确对角化对比验证微观精度与动力学关联一致性，大规模模拟重现多尺度电荷有序与电荷密度波粗化。
AI.conclusion: 为具有有限晶格点群的体系提供了一种易用、可复用的对称性保持多体动力学建模途径。

title: Solid-State Dealloying Enables Local Symmetry Breaking in Ternary Intermetallic Thin Films
summary: Metastable quantum materials often occupy narrow composition windows with local symmetries distinct from competing equilibrium structures. These features open pathways for realizing qualitatively new electronic properties within a similar chemical subspace while at the same time complicating their deterministic synthesis. Here we illustrate a post-growth solid-state dealloying process using epitaxial ternary thin films in the La--Ag--Ge chemical space to realize a diffraction-averaged centrosymmetric superconducting structure. The process converts polar $P6_3mc$-LaAgGe into diffraction-averaged centrosymmetric AlB$_2$-type $P6/mmm$ La-Ag-Ge through net Ag loss during annealing at 800--900 $^\circ$C. Atomic-resolution electron microscopy reveals local Ag--Ge displacements of both signs relative to the planar configuration, consistent with local inversion-symmetry-breaking distortions. The converted films exhibit composition-dependent superconductivity with critical temperatures below 1 K and in-plane upper critical fields that exceed the weak-coupling Pauli-field estimate by a factor of approximately 6 in the thinnest superconducting films. These results establish epitaxial solid-state dealloying as a route to phase-selective synthesis of metastable phases, offering control over atomic-scale structural configurations and their interplay with emergent electronic properties.

AI.tldr: 本文报道一种后生长固态去合金化方法，通过退火使极性P6₃mc-LaAgGe失去Ag，转变为衍射平均显示中心对称的AlB₂型P6/mmm La-Ag-Ge，并获得成分依赖的超导电性。
AI.motivation: 亚稳量子材料常处于狭窄成分窗口，其局部对称性与竞争平衡结构不同，既可能带来新奇电子性质，又使其确定性合成变得困难，因此需要一种能相选择性合成亚稳相的方法。
AI.method: 在La-Ag-Ge化学空间中使用外延三元薄膜，通过800–900 °C退火实现固态去合金化，使Ag净流失，将P6₃mc-LaAgGe转化为衍射平均中心对称的P6/mmm AlB₂型结构，并用原子分辨电子显微镜表征局域结构。
AI.result: 电子显微镜显示存在正负两种符号的局域Ag-Ge位移，与局域反演对称破缺畸变一致；转化后的薄膜表现出成分依赖超导电性，临界温度低于1 K，最薄超导薄膜的面内上临界场约为弱耦合Pauli极限估计的6倍。
AI.conclusion: 该工作确立了外延固态去合金化作为亚稳相相选择性合成的一条路径，可调控原子尺度结构构型及其与涌现电子性质之间的相互作用。

title: On quantum confinement without barriers
comment: 4 pages + 1 page of Supplementary Materials, 3 figures
summary: Usually in semiconductor heterostructures, such as quantum wells, the quantum confinement is realized by means of heterobarriers, which are simply the band offsets in adjacent materials. Here the arguments are provided, that the energy dispersions in materials (in simple case determined by effective masses) are important as well. Using a simple model system, such as quantum well with an additional heterojunction, it is shown the predominant localization of the carrier density in the regions with higher effective mass. The possibility of different spatial localization of wave function for different subbands is predicted. This can be applied in semiconductor structures such as quantum cascade lasers.

AI.tldr: 本文指出，半导体异质结构中量子限制不仅由异质势垒（能带偏移）决定，材料能量色散（有效质量）也起重要作用；通过含附加异质结的量子阱模型，展示了载流子密度倾向于在有效质量较高区域局域，并预测不同子带波函数可空间局域于不同位置。
AI.motivation: 传统观点认为量子阱等异质结构中的量子限制主要由异质势垒（相邻材料的能带偏移）实现。本文旨在论证材料本身的能量色散（简单情况下由有效质量决定）同样重要，补充对量子限制机制的理解。
AI.method: 采用简单模型体系，如带有一个附加异质结的量子阱，分析能量色散/有效质量对载流子空间分布的影响。
AI.result: 发现载流子密度主要局域在有效质量较高的区域；并预测不同子带的波函数可以具有不同的空间局域位置。
AI.conclusion: 有效质量（能量色散）是决定半导体异质结构中量子限制与波函数空间局域的重要因素；该效应可应用于量子级联激光器等半导体结构。

title: On the Electronic Path-Integral Normal Modes of the Spin-Mapping Representation of Nonadiabatic Dynamics
summary: Nonadiabatic Matsubara dynamics has been proposed in both the Meyer-Miller-Stock-Thoss (MMST) and spin-mapping representations, whereby the dynamics are truncated in the higher path-integral normal modes of the nuclear degrees of freedom, but no truncation is performed in the electronic variables. In contrast to single-surface Matsubara dynamics, these methods do not appear to conserve the Quantum Boltzmann Distribution (QBD) for general systems. Recently, it was shown that truncating in the electronic path-integral normal modes of the MMST representation does not lead to conservation of the QBD for a single trajectory or accurate computation of a correlation function. Here, the electronic path-integral normal modes in the spin-mapping representation are investigated. We focus on a two-level system although we expect our findings to be applicable to any number of electronic states. We find, perhaps surprisingly, that the higher normal modes of the spin-vector $z$-component, the difference in state populations, are constrained by the QBD, that the time-evolved state population observable is a function of only the spin-mapping centroid, and that the full $N$-bead computational results are replicated using only the spin-mapping centroid, leading to accurate, QBD conserving dynamics. While at present these results are not a generally-applicable method, we believe this may explain the recent success of spin-mapping approaches compared to MMST approaches, %To our knowledge, this is the first method obtaining conservation of the QBD when truncating in electronic normal modes and should aid the future derivation of highly accurate and Quantum Boltzmann conserving nonadiabatic dynamics methods.

AI.tldr: 研究自旋映射表示中电子路径积分简正模，发现在两级系统中高简正模受QBD约束，仅用自旋映射质心即可复现全N-珠结果，实现精确且守恒QBD的动力学。
AI.motivation: 非绝热Matsubara动力学在MMST与自旋映射表示中截断核简正模但不截断电子变量，一般系统下不守恒量子玻尔兹曼分布(QBD)。近期证明MMST电子简正模截断不守恒QBD，故需考察自旋映射表示的电子简正模行为。
AI.method: 针对两级系统（预期可推广至任意电子态数），分析自旋映射表示中电子路径积分简正模，重点考察自旋矢量z分量（态布居差）的高简正模与QBD的关系及质心依赖。
AI.result: 发现自旋矢量z分量的高简正模被QBD约束；时间演化的态布居可观测量仅是自旋映射质心的函数；仅用自旋映射质心即可复现全N-珠计算结果，得到精确且守恒QBD的动力学。
AI.conclusion: 尽管当前尚非通用方法，该结果可解释自旋映射相较MMST的成功，并据作者所知是首个在电子简正模截断时守恒QBD的方法，有助于未来推导高精度且守恒QBD的非绝热动力学方法。

title: Towards Extended Active Learning for Modelling Ferroelectric Switching: the Need for 'Gold Standards'
summary: For the purpose of modelling ferroelectric switching in wurtzite-structured materials, four cost-effective density-functional theory (DFT) methods (PBE, PBEsol, r2SCAN, and r2SCAN-rVV10) are considered and compared to various ab initio approaches based on the random-phase approximation (RPA), including RPA with singles corrections (RPAR+S), as well as second-order Møller-Plesset perturbation theory (MP2). The purpose is to determine whether an ab initio approach could act as a 'gold standard' for estimating the reliability of DFT, thus determining an optimal DFT method for use in exhaustive tasks such as the training of machine-learning interatomic potentials (MLIP) for large-scale simulations of materials of arbitrary composition and structure such as Al1-xScxN and Zn1-xMgxO, using AlN, Al0.5Sc0.5N, ZnO, and Zn0.5Mg0.5O as model materials. Applications of active learning (AL) are now common, in which results from MLIP simulations are used to enhance the DFT training data set, but future extended active learning (EAL) methods will also need to systematically assess the DFT methodology against a gold standard. Herein, the variability of the ab initio results is found to exceed that required for a robust gold standard, but the DFT and ab initio approaches appear to converge on RPAR+S and r2SCAN-rVV10 as optimal method choices to initiate EAL. The electron correlation energy is found to be dominated by covalent binding effects associated with the high-electron-density anions involved, but the van der Waals dispersion force is seen to be too significant to ignore in ferroelectric modelling.

AI.tldr: 本文将四种低成本DFT方法（PBE、PBEsol、r2SCAN、r2SCAN-rVV10）与基于RPA和MP2的从头算方法进行对比，评估其在纤锌矿材料铁电开关建模中的可靠性，以确定适合大规模MLIP训练的DFT方法。
AI.motivation: 为纤锌矿材料（如AlScN、ZnMgO）的铁电开关建模寻找最优DFT方法，用于训练机器学习原子间势（MLIP）。未来扩展主动学习（EAL）需要系统评估DFT方法，因此需确定一个"黄金标准"从头算方法来衡量DFT可靠性。
AI.method: 以AlN、Al0.5Sc0.5N、ZnO、Zn0.5Mg0.5O为模型材料，比较PBE、PBEsol、r2SCAN、r2SCAN-rVV10四种DFT方法与RPA、RPAR+S及MP2等从头算方法的结果。
AI.result: 从头算结果之间的差异超过了稳健黄金标准所需水平；但DFT与从头算方法均收敛指向RPAR+S和r2SCAN-rVV10为启动EAL的最优方法。电子相关能主要由高电子密度阴离子的共价键结合效应主导，而范德华色散力在铁电建模中不可忽略。
AI.conclusion: RPAR+S和r2SCAN-rVV10是启动扩展主动学习的最佳方法选择；铁电建模中必须考虑范德华色散效应，且缺乏足够稳健的从头算黄金标准。

title: First Passage in the Presence of Jump Rate Fluctuations: A Transition from Infinite to Finite Mean
summary: A simple symmetric random walk on a one-dimensional lattice is guaranteed to reach any target site, yet its mean first-passage time diverges. Here, we show that stochastic fluctuations in the jump rate can fundamentally alter this classic result. We find a phase transition in the mean first-passage time: sufficiently broad rate fluctuations render it finite, whereas weaker fluctuations leave it infinite. Our results demonstrate that temporal fluctuations in the jump rate---and hence in the diffusivity---can overcome spatial wandering and regularize otherwise divergent first-passage times.

AI.tldr: 该文研究一维格点上跳跃速率的时间随机涨落对首达时间的影响，发现首达时间存在相变：涨落足够宽时平均首达时间变为有限，涨落较弱时仍为无穷。
AI.motivation: 经典一维对称随机游走虽能到达任意目标点，但平均首达时间发散。作者希望探究跳跃速率（即扩散率）的时间涨落能否改变这一经典结论。
AI.method: 在一维格点随机游走模型中引入跳跃速率的随机时间涨落，并分析平均首达时间随涨落强度的变化。
AI.result: 发现平均首达时间存在相变：涨落足够宽时平均首达时间变为有限，涨落较弱时仍为无穷。
AI.conclusion: 跳跃速率乃至扩散率的时间涨落可以克服空间游走，正则化原本发散的首达时间，揭示了涨落对首达过程的根本性作用。

title: Mobility-Gap Robustness and Středa-Hall Separation in Disordered Axion Pumping
summary: We show that the noncommutative second Chern number of a $(3+1)$D disordered axion pump remains quantized beyond global spectral gap closure at $W_g \approx 14.5$. Large-scale computation of the second Chern number and finite-size scaling demonstrate convergence of $\mathrm{Ch}_2$ toward $-1$ well into the mobility-gap regime ($W \lesssim 16.5$), while the Středa-Hall response $\partial_φ\mathrm{Ch}_{0,3}$ departs rapidly after global spectral gap closure, serving as an internal control that distinguishes bulk mobility-gap protection from finite-size artifacts. Level statistics identify a 3D unitary Anderson transition at each pump slice and locate the mobility-edge bottleneck at $τ=0$, with critical disorder $W_c \approx 18$.

AI.tldr: 本文证明(3+1)维无序轴子泵的非交换第二陈数在全局谱隙关闭后仍保持量子化，直至迁移率隙区，并给出临界无序强度。
AI.motivation: 检验无序轴子泵的第二陈数量子化是否依赖全局谱隙，区分迁移率隙保护与有限尺寸伪影。
AI.method: 大规模计算第二陈数与有限尺寸标度分析，对比Středa-Hall响应作为内部控制，并用能级统计定位Anderson转变。
AI.result: Ch₂在W≲16.5收敛至-1，超出全局谱隙关闭点W_g≈14.5；∂_φCh₀,₃在谱隙关闭后迅速偏离；每个泵切片存在3D酉类Anderson转变，迁移率边瓶颈位于τ=0，W_c≈18。
AI.conclusion: 第二陈数量子化受迁移率隙保护而非全局谱隙约束。

title: Thermodynamic Uncertainty Relations in Chaotic Andreev Billiards
summary: We investigate how particle-hole symmetry, quantum interference, and tunnel barriers shape thermodynamic uncertainty relations in chaotic Andreev billiards. Using random-matrix theory and the Mahaux-Weidenmüller scattering approach, we study charge conductance and shot noise across the four Altland-Zirnbauer symmetry classes, from the single-channel extreme quantum limit to the multichannel semiclassical regime and from ideal to opaque contacts. We characterize thermodynamic precision through two complementary ensemble observables: either by averaging the sample-resolved noise-to-conductance ratio, or from the separately averaging noise and conductance. Their pronounced discrepancy in the extreme quantum regime reveals the non-self-averaging character of mesoscopic transport and persists over a broad range of barrier transparencies. For ideal contacts, the first provides a sensitive fingerprint of the Altland-Zirnbauer symmetry class. In the opaque regime, this hierarchy changes. Despite these strong symmetry- and barrier-dependent effects, the standard thermodynamic uncertainty relation remains satisfied throughout all regimes investigated. Our results establish thermodynamic uncertainty as a symmetry-sensitive probe of universal transport in chaotic normal-superconducting systems.

AI.tldr: 本文用随机矩阵理论与Mahaux-Weidenmüller散射方法，研究混沌Andreev腔中粒子-空穴对称性、量子干涉和隧穿势垒对热力学不确定关系的影响。
AI.motivation: 探究Andreev腔中对称性、量子干涉与隧穿势垒如何塑造热力学不确定关系，并以热力学精度作为探针刻画正常-超导混沌体系的普适输运。
AI.method: 采用随机矩阵理论和Mahaux-Weidenmüller散射方法，在四个Altland-Zirnbauer对称类中研究电导与散粒噪声；覆盖从单通道极端量子极限到多通道半经典区制、从理想接触到不透明接触的区间；并用两种互补集合观测量刻画热力学精度（样本分辨的噪声-电导比之平均，与分别平均噪声与电导）。
AI.result: 两种观测量在极端量子区制出现显著差异，揭示介观输运的非自平均特性，且在较大势垒透明范围内持续。理想接触下，第一种量提供Altland-Zirnbauer对称类的敏感指纹；不透明区制下该层级发生改变。尽管如此，标准热力学不确定关系在所有区制中仍被满足。
AI.conclusion: 热力学不确定性可作为混沌正常-超导体系中普适输运的对称性敏感探针。

title: Separating multi-particle dynamics by intensity cycling
summary: We address the interpretation of transient spectroscopy signals proportional to average excitation number in terms of discrete number of excitations. Building on our recent intensity cycling approach, we derive a general scheme to isolate multi-particle dynamics from any transient signal under minimal assumptions. The key result is a general formula expressing the extracted nonlinear signal terms by multi-excitation propagators. We demonstrate the approach on exciton transport and annihilation in organic nanoparticles, and carrier recombination in silicon nanocrystals.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个通用方案，将瞬态光谱信号（正比于平均激发数）转化为离散激发数表示，从而在极少假设下分离多粒子动力学。
AI.motivation: 瞬态光谱信号通常反映平均激发数，难以直接解读为离散的激发数量，导致多粒子动力学信息难以从中提取。
AI.method: 在作者近期"强度循环"方法基础上，推导出一个通用框架，给出用多激发传播子表达所提取非线性信号项的通用公式。
AI.result: 在有机纳米颗粒的激子输运与湮灭、以及硅纳米晶的载流子复合两个体系上验证了该方法的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 该通用框架可在最小假设下从任意瞬态信号中分离多粒子动力学，为瞬态光谱的离散激发数解读提供了普适工具。

title: Electric-field switchable interlayer magnetic order and anomalous valley Hall effect in Janus VSSe bilayers with different interfaces
summary: Electric-field control of magnetic order and valley polarization holds great promise for spintronic and valleytronic applications. However, achieving such electrical modulation remains a fundamental challenge in two-dimensional (2D) van der Waals (vdW) magnets. Herein, via first-principles calculations, we verify that electrically tunable interlayer magnetic order and valley polarization can be realized in Janus VSSe bilayers with different interfaces. Although the magnitudes of dipole moments within each constituent Janus monolayer are identical, the vertical built-in electrostatic potential difference $Δφ$ across the bilayer depends strongly on the orientations of these dipoles, which originates from the distinct interfacial configurations. As a consequence, the VSSe bilayers with different interfaces possess distinct interlayer magnetic couplings and show dramatically varied responses to external electric fields. For Se-S interface, reversible electric-field switching between antiferromagnetic (AFM) and ferromagnetic (FM) states can be achieved due to the competition between itinerant-electron-mediated FM exchange coupling and interlayer $Δφ$-dependent AFM/FM super-superexchange interactions mediated by interfacial Se and S atoms. For Se-Se interface, both the valley polarization and spin splitting can be effectively reversed by the out-of-plane electric field, realizing an all-electric-field controlled anomalous valley Hall effect. Our results demonstrate that the interface of the magnetic Janus bilayer could act as an additional degree of freedom to tune the electronic, magnetic, and valley properties in 2D vdW materials. The Janus VSSe bilayers are identified as a promising platform for the design of low-power spintronic and valleytronic devices.

AI.tldr: 通过第一性原理计算，发现Janus VSSe双层因界面取向不同而具有不同的层间磁耦合与电场响应，可实现电场调控的磁序与谷极化。
AI.motivation: 电场调控磁序与谷极化对自旋电子学和谷电子学应用意义重大，但在二维范德华磁体中实现这种电调控仍是基础性挑战。
AI.method: 采用第一性原理计算，研究具有不同界面（Se-S与Se-Se）的Janus VSSe双层的层间磁序与谷极化，并考察外电场的影响。
AI.result: 不同界面导致跨层静电势差Δφ差异显著，从而产生不同的层间磁耦合与电场响应：Se-S界面可实现AFM-FM的可逆电场切换；Se-Se界面的谷极化和自旋劈裂可被垂直电场有效反转，实现全电场控制的异常谷霍尔效应。
AI.conclusion: Janus双层界面可作为调控二维范德华材料电子、磁性和谷性质的新自由度，Janus VSSe双层是低功耗自旋与谷电子器件的潜在平台。

title: Uphill and downhill first passage of an active Brownian particle: Asymmetry and exact path reweighting
summary: First passage processes in active systems combine stochastic transport with self-propulsion and orientational persistence, making motion along and against an external bias sensitive to the internal active dynamics. For passive biased diffusion, opposite exits can have different splitting probabilities while their conditional first passage time distributions remain identical. We study how this relation changes for an active Brownian particle driven by a constant external force between two absorbing boundaries. Self-propulsion breaks the equality of the uphill and downhill first passage time distributions and modifies the splitting probabilities. Nevertheless, the two directional path ensembles remain exactly related by spatial reflection, which pairs downhill and uphill first passage paths of the same duration while preserving their orientational history. The log-ratio of the probabilities of a path and its reflected partner defines a path-dependent asymmetry functional and provides an exact reweighting between the two ensembles. In the symmetric half-weighted representation, the uphill and downhill first passage time distributions coincide for arbitrary orientational persistence. The same path relation also allows rare uphill statistics to be reconstructed from the more frequently sampled downhill trajectories. Numerical simulations confirm the weighted equality across the explored bias and persistence regimes, while perturbative and asymptotic analyses clarify how orientational persistence produces the directional asymmetry of the unweighted statistics. The exact relation between the two directional path ensembles suggests that similar symmetry-based reconstruction protocols may be found in other nonequilibrium first-passage problems.

AI.tldr: 研究活性布朗粒子在恒外力下穿越两个吸收边界的首达问题，发现定向路径集合间存在精确的空间反射关系，可用来重加权两方向分布并从下坡轨迹重建稀有的上坡统计。
AI.motivation: 被动偏置扩散中，相反出口的分裂概率不同但条件首达时间分布相同；本文探究自推进与取向持续性如何破坏这一关系，并寻找活性系统中仍然成立的方向性对称性。
AI.method: 以恒外力驱动的活性布朗粒子在两个吸收边界间运动为模型，建立下坡与上坡首达路径之间严格的空间反射配对（保持取向历史与持续时间），由此定义路径依赖的非对称泛函并进行精确重加权；结合数值模拟、微扰与渐近分析。
AI.result: 自推进破坏上下坡首达时间分布的相等性并改变分裂概率，但两方向路径集合仍精确由空间反射相联系；在半权重表示下，任意取向持续性下上坡与下坡首达时间分布完全重合。数值模拟验证了加权相等性，微扰与渐近分析揭示了取向持续性如何产生无权重统计的方向非对称性。
AI.conclusion: 活性首达过程中存在基于对称性的精确路径关系，可用于从易采样的下坡轨迹重建稀有上坡统计，暗示其他非平衡首达问题中也可能存在类似的重建协议。

title: Multiscale Entropies as Order Parameters for Nonequilibrium Phase Transitions
summary: We develop a multiscale entropy framework based on the wavelet conditional renormalization group that decomposes the total Shannon entropy into contributions from different spatial scales. Generative modeling enables accurate estimation of these entropies from configurations or snapshots, even in nonequilibrium systems whose underlying probability distributions are unknown. Applications to the equilibrium $\varphi^4$ model and nonequilibrium active Model B+ show that multiscale entropies reveal criticality and spatial organization obscured in the total entropy. These entropies serve as scale-dependent order parameters for characterizing phase transitions and pattern formation.

AI.tldr: 提出基于小波条件重整化群的多尺度熵框架，用小波将总Shannon熵分解为不同空间尺度的贡献，并借助生成模型从快照中估计这些熵，可用于刻画相变与斑图形成。
AI.motivation: 总Shannon熵往往掩盖了系统在空间尺度上的结构信息，对非平衡系统尤其如此，需要一种能分解熵到不同空间尺度的方法以揭示被掩盖的临界性与空间组织。
AI.method: 构建小波条件重整化群的多尺度熵框架，将总Shannon熵分解为各空间尺度的贡献；利用生成建模从构型或快照中精确估计这些熵，无需已知底层概率分布，从而适用于非平衡系统。
AI.result: 在平衡φ⁴模型与非平衡active Model B+上的应用表明，多尺度熵能揭示总熵中被掩盖的临界性与空间组织。
AI.conclusion: 这些多尺度熵可作为尺度依赖的序参量，用于表征相变与斑图形成。

title: Asymmetric magnetoresistance in 3$d$-5$d$ based La$_{0.67}$Ca$_{0.33}$MnO$_3$/SrIrO$_3$ bilayer: The role of unidirectional anisotropy
summary: The complex interplay between spin-orbit coupling, magnetism, and magnetic field at the interface of a heterostructure consisting of ferromagnet (FM) and heavy metal (HM), often exhibit extraordinary magnetic and electric phenomena where an in-plane Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya (DM) interaction plays a crucial role to stabilize local spin texture in FM layer. Here, we report detailed magnetic and magneto-transport behaviour on an epitaxially grown thin heterostructure with 3$d$ FM La$_{0.67}$Ca$_{0.33}$MnO$_3$ (LCMO) and 5$d$ HM SrIrO$_3$ (SIO). Magnetic measurements show an unusual development of magnetic ordering in SrIrO3 around 42 K, which further leads to a Mn/Ir magnetic coupling at the interface. The magnetoresistance (MR) measurements show an evolution of its value and shape with the magnetic state of this bilayer. While MR is negative at high temperature, it shows a positive to negative crossover with stable magnetic ordering of LCMO, and finally the positive MR exhibits an asymmetry at low temperature with the ordering of SIO. While we ascribe this unusual MR behaviour to interface-driven varying spin scattering between itinerant and localized electrons, our results shed a light to comprehend the complex but tunable interface behavior on charge transport in a particularly designed heterostructure, offering valuable insights for future functional material engineering.

AI.tldr: 研究LCMO/SrIrO3外延异质结的磁性与磁输运行为，发现SrIrO3在42 K出现磁性有序及界面Mn/Ir磁耦合，磁电阻随磁态演化呈现符号交叉与低温不对称正MR。
AI.motivation: 铁磁体/重金属界面中自旋轨道耦合、磁性与磁场的相互作用可产生奇特现象，其中面内DM相互作用对稳定局域自旋结构至关重要，但界面驱动的电荷输运机制尚需深入理解。
AI.method: 制备3d铁磁体LCMO与5d重金属SrIrO3的外延异质结，开展详细的磁测量与磁输运（磁电阻）测量。
AI.result: SrIrO3在约42 K出现异常磁有序，导致界面Mn/Ir磁耦合；MR随磁态演化，高温为负，随LCMO磁性有序出现正负交叉，低温下随SIO有序呈不对称正MR。
AI.conclusion: 异常MR行为归因于界面驱动的巡游电子与局域电子间变化的spintronic散射，揭示可调控界面行为对电荷输运的影响，为功能材料工程提供启示。

title: Spectroscopic signatures of persistent exciton condensation in a bulk magnetic topological insulator
summary: Exciton condensates are long-sought correlated quantum states arising from macroscopic coherence of bound electron-hole pairs. Although equilibrium and transient excitonic states have been reported in several material platforms, direct evidence for a light-induced exciton condensate state has been challenging to achieve as an intrinsic property of a bulk quantum material. Here, we use time- and angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy to investigate long-lived photoexcited carriers in the intrinsic magnetic topological insulator MnBi$_2$Te$_4$ with the chemical potential tuned to the topological surface state by Sb substitution. Following optical excitation, we observe the delayed emergence of a transient state whose formation coincides with depopulation of the bulk conduction band and whose lifetime extends to the microsecond timescale. The quasiparticle dispersion exhibits a pronounced flattening and develops a Mexican-hat-like profile. These spectral signatures are consistent with the formation of a metastable excitonic condensate state. Our results establish magnetic topological insulators as a promising platform for investigating long-lived photoinduced many-body states and their interplay with topology and magnetism.

AI.tldr: 本文利用时间分辨与角分辨光电子能谱，在磁性拓扑绝缘体MnBi₂Te₄中观察到长寿命光激发载流子形成具有"墨西哥帽"色散特征的瞬态态，其证据支持亚稳激子凝聚态的形成。
AI.motivation: 激子凝聚态是源于束缚电子-空穴对宏观相干性的关联量子态，尽管已在多种材料平台报道平衡与瞬态激子态，但作为块体量子材料本征属性的光诱导激子凝聚态仍缺乏直接证据。作者旨在寻找并表征这种长寿命光诱导多体态。
AI.method: 采用时间分辨与角分辨光电子能谱（tr-ARPES），研究通过Sb替代将化学势调至拓扑表面态的磁性拓扑绝缘体MnBi₂Te₄中的长寿命光激发载流子。观测光学激发后瞬态态的出现、其与体能带导带去布居的关联，以及准粒子色散的变化。
AI.result: 光学激发后，瞬态态延迟出现，其形成与体导带去布居同时发生，寿命延伸至微秒量级。准粒子色散显著变平，并呈现出"墨西哥帽"状分布，这些谱学特征与亚稳激子凝聚态的形成一致。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明磁性拓扑绝缘体可作为研究长寿命光诱导多体态及其与拓扑、磁性相互作用的理想平台。

title: Simulation of a Battery Cell on Quantum Computers: Reactions & Transport
summary: Simulations of electrochemical materials and systems accelerate technological progress, but are still limited by computational power. In particular, quantum computing offers prospects for higher resolutions, due to the exponential amount of data that can be stored in a quantum state. As current quantum computers are still noisy, we consider a hybrid quantum-classical algorithm, that divides the problem into smaller computational tasks. We describe how to implement such an algorithm for non-linear partial differential equations, the Feynman-Kitaev Hamiltonian, in a scalable way for an electrochemical system. We show how it can evaluate general electrochemical models and present a quantum simulation of the Single Particle Model with electrolyte (SPMe) as the first quantum simulation of a battery cell.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种混合量子-经典算法，将非线性偏微分方程（Feynman-Kitaev哈密顿量）分解为小任务以适配含噪量子计算机，并首次实现了电池单元（SPMe模型）的量子模拟。
AI.motivation: 电化学材料与系统的模拟受限于计算能力，而量子计算凭借量子态指数级存储能力有望实现更高分辨率。
AI.method: 采用混合量子-经典算法，针对非线性偏微分方程（Feynman-Kitaev哈密顿量）以可扩展方式分解问题，适配当前含噪量子计算机。
AI.result: 能够评估一般电化学模型，并完成了单粒子模型含电解质（SPMe）的量子模拟，这是首个电池单元的量子模拟。
AI.conclusion: 该工作展示了混合量子-经典方法在电化学系统量子模拟中的可行性，为更高分辨率的电化学模拟开辟了道路。

title: Fractionation as a Tool to Control Mn/Al Site Mixing and Magnetism in CaMn_{2+x}Al_{10-x}
summary: We report single crystal growth and physical property characterization of CaMn_{2+x}Al_{10-x} crystals grown using a fractionation approach. Three consecutive batches were obtained from the same initial melt composition, systematically sampling neighboring, narrow regions of the ternary Ca-Mn-Al phase diagram. Single-crystal X-ray diffraction measurements reveal Mn/Al site mixing, with the excess Mn concentration, x, decreasing systematically with decreasing decanting temperature. A low-temperature upturn in magnetization and a maximum in electrical resistivity both become progressively weaker with decreasing excess Mn content, suggesting that the previously reported magnetic properties attributed to stoichiometric CaMn_{2}Al_{10} instead arise from an inhomogeneous distribution of excess Mn atoms. More broadly, the results presented in this work demonstrate how fractionation can help distinguish intrinsic magnetic behavior from disorder-induced effects associated with an inhomogeneous distribution of magnetic ions in materials with a finite width of formation, particularly when itinerant magnetism is under consideration.

AI.tldr: 采用分凝法生长CaMn_{2+x}Al_{10-x}单晶，发现过量Mn分布不均而非化学计量比是磁性的来源。
AI.motivation: 此前报道的化学计量CaMn_{2}Al_{10}磁性可能源于过量Mn原子的不均匀分布，需通过系统调控Mn含量来区分本征磁性。
AI.method: 用分凝(fractionation)法从同一初始熔体连续生长三批晶体，取样Ca-Mn-Al相图相邻窄区域；用单晶XRD表征Mn/Al位点混占。
AI.result: XRD显示Mn/Al位点混占，过量Mn浓度x随倾析温度降低而减小；低温磁化上翘与电阻率极大值随x减小而变弱。
AI.conclusion: 分凝法可区分本征磁性与磁性离子不均匀分布引起的无序效应，尤其适用于巡游磁性材料。

title: SoLiD26: A First Principles Solid-Liquid Interface Dataset for Machine-learned Interatomic Potentials
summary: Machine-learned interatomic potentials (MLIPs) for solid-liquid interfaces in advanced materials applications, e.g., electrochemistry, catalysis and corrosion, require training data that samples both liquid environments, the solid and the interface itself. We present SoLiD26, a curated solid-liquid interface dataset, containing 15.4 million first-principles atomic structures with up to 576 atoms and 15 chemical elements for training and evaluating MLIPs. The structures were compiled from density functional theory (DFT) calculations performed in studies of solid-liquid interfaces, with most configurations originating from ab initio molecular dynamics (AIMD) simulations. Each record contains atomic species, positions, simulation cell, periodic boundary conditions, potential energy and atomic forces. SoLiD26 includes aqueous coinage metal interfaces, electrode-electrolyte systems, and selected bulk reference structures, calculated with VASP using the PBE functional and D3 dispersion corrections. We describe the data ingestion and preparation pipeline used to construct the dataset. The application of SoLiD26 for training and evaluating MLIPs is demonstrated with a suite of MACE models on a simple training, validation and test split. The dataset enables development and benchmarking of MLIPs for structurally and chemically heterogeneous solid-liquid interfaces.

AI.tldr: 本文发布SoLiD26，一个含1540万第一性原理结构、覆盖15种元素、最大576原子的固液界面数据集，用于训练与评估机器学习原子间势（MLIPs）。
AI.motivation: 固液界面MLIPs（用于电化学、催化、腐蚀）需要同时覆盖液体、固体和界面区域的训练数据，但此类高质量数据稀缺。
AI.method: 整合固液界面研究的DFT计算数据（多来自AIMD），采用VASP、PBE泛函和D3色散校正；每条记录含原子种类、位置、模拟盒子、周期性边界、势能与原子力；并给出数据摄取与制备流程。用MACE模型按简单训练/验证/测试划分进行验证。
AI.result: 构建了含15.4M结构、最多576原子、15种元素的SoLiD26，涵盖水系币金属界面、电极-电解质体系及部分体相参考结构；MACE模型验证了其训练与评估可行性。
AI.conclusion: SoLiD26支持结构化学异质固液界面MLIPs的开发与基准测试。

title: Intrinsic anomalous Hall effect in the surface conduction regime of non-magnetic narrow-gap insulator FeSi
summary: The realization of an intrinsic anomalous Hall effect (AHE) in the absence of bulk magnetism is a rare phenomenon, requiring a spontaneous breaking of the time-reversal symmetry within the boundary states without a thermodynamic phase transition. Here, we report a robust, zero-field-hysteretic intrinsic AHE confined to the low-temperature surface-conduction regime of the prototypical narrow-gap insulator FeSi. By systematically investigating single crystals grown via Czochralski and chemical vapor transport methods with controlled thicknesses and surface preparations, we demonstrate that low-temperature electrical conductivity correlates with surface roughness and anti-correlates with sample thickness, confirming the emergence of surface conducting states (CSS) below $T_{\rm CSS} \simeq 55-75\text{ K}$. Meanwhile, a robust, field-hysteretic and temperature-independent anomalous Hall conductivity is found below $T_{\rm AHE}\simeq45-70\text{ K}$, implying the presence of magnetic order in the surface conduction regime. Bulk magnetic susceptibility and specific-heat measurements reveal no thermodynamic phase transitions, verifying that the sample interior remains a non-magnetic insulator. Analyses of conductivity scaling and effective three-dimensional conductivity reveal the intrinsic nature of this surface-driven AHE, evidencing the presence of an emergent magnetic order within the metallic surface of a non-magnetic bulk insulator. These findings establish FeSi as a compelling platform to investigate the interplay between strong electron correlations and anomalous Hall transport.

AI.tldr: 在窄禁带绝缘体FeSi的低温表面导电态中，发现零场下具有磁滞、反常霍尔效应（AHE），源于表面金属层中涌现的磁有序，而体态保持非磁绝缘。
AI.motivation: 在无体磁性的情况下实现本征反常霍尔效应极为罕见，需在无热力学相变的前提下于边界态中自发破缺时间反演对称性，本文旨在探索这一现象。
AI.method: 通过Czochralski和化学气相输运法生长不同厚度、不同表面处理的FeSi单晶，系统测量电导率与表面粗糙度、厚度的关系，并结合磁化率、比热以及电导标度和有效三维电导分析。
AI.result: 在T_CSS≈55-75 K以下出现表面导电态，且在T_AHE≈45-70 K以下观测到稳健、具场磁滞、温度无关的反常霍尔电导；体磁化率和比热无热力学相变，证实体内为非磁绝缘体。
AI.conclusion: 该表面驱动的AHE为本征效应，表明非磁体绝缘体金属表面存在涌现磁有序，确立FeSi为研究强电子关联与反常霍尔输运相互作用的平台。

title: Resonantly Enhanced Phonon Transport by Magnon Pumping in a Ferromagnetic/Piezoelectric Bilayer
summary: We report the first experimental observation of resonantly enhanced propagating phonon transport induced by magnon pumping in a ferromagnetic/piezoelectric bilayer. Surface acoustic waves (SAWs) generated in a 128$^{\circ}$ Y-cut LiNbO$_3$ delay-line device resonantly excite magnetization dynamics in an adjacent Co film through magnetoelastic coupling. The enhancement of the transmitted acoustic signal occurs exclusively when the SAW frequency satisfies the ferromagnetic resonance condition predicted by the Kittel dispersion, providing a direct experimental fingerprint of resonant magnon-phonon coupling. A systematic comparison between the Co/LiNbO$_3$ bilayer and the bare LiNbO$_3$ substrate demonstrates that the observed transmission enhancement originates solely from the dynamic interaction between propagating phonons and coherent magnetization precession. Furthermore, measurements performed at different SAW harmonics reveal that only the harmonic satisfying the FMR condition produces a measurable enhancement, confirming the frequency-selective nature of the phenomenon. These findings establish an efficient mechanism for transferring energy from magnons to propagating phonons and provide a new strategy for actively controlling coherent acoustic transport in hybrid spintronic, straintronic, and quantum phononic platforms.

AI.tldr: 首次在铁磁/压电双层中实验观察到由磁振子泵浦诱导的共振增强声子输运。
AI.motivation: 探索磁振子与声子之间的共振耦合，寻求能量从磁振子向传播声子转移的机制，并实现对相干声学输运的主动调控。
AI.method: 在128°Y切LiNbO₃延迟线器件中产生表面声波（SAW），通过磁弹耦合共振激发相邻Co薄膜的磁化动力学；系统比较Co/LiNbO₃双层与裸LiNbO₃基底，并在不同SAW谐波下进行测量。
AI.result: 仅当SAW频率满足Kittel色散预测的铁磁共振条件时，透射声信号才增强；该增强仅源于传播声子与相干磁化进动之间的动态相互作用，且只有满足FMR条件的谐波才产生可测增强，证实了频率选择性。
AI.conclusion: 确立了从磁振子向传播声子高效转移能量的机制，为在自旋电子学、应变电子学和量子声学混合平台中主动控制相干声学输运提供了新策略。

title: Physics-guided inverse design of Co-based superalloys using machine learning and multi-objective optimization for enhanced $γ'$ solvus temperature
summary: The discovery of next-generation Co-based superalloys with improved high-temperature stability is hindered by the vast compositional design space and complex interactions among alloying elements governing gamma-prime phase stability. This study presents a physics-informed machine learning framework for the inverse design of Co-based superalloys with higher gamma-prime solvus temperature while accounting for alloy density. Four descriptors representing atomic size mismatch (delta-MV), mixing enthalpy (Delta-Hm), electronegativity mismatch (delta-EN), and valence electron concentration mismatch (delta-VEC) were used to characterize the chemistry governing phase stability. Regression algorithms were evaluated using leave-one-out cross-validation, with Gaussian Process Regression (GPR) achieving the best performance (R2 = 0.932, RMSE = 34.7 deg C, and MAE = 25.9 deg C). The probabilistic nature of GPR enabled uncertainty-aware Bayesian optimization for exploring the uncharted composition space. Non-dominated Sorting Genetic Algorithm II (NSGA-II) and Genetic Algorithms were used to simultaneously increase gamma-prime solvus temperature and reduce alloy density. The optimization generated numerous previously unexplored Co-based alloy compositions, with predicted gamma-prime solvus temperatures of 1248-1353 deg C, including candidates approaching or exceeding the maximum value in the experimental dataset. Descriptor analysis identified atomic size mismatch and mixing enthalpy as key factors governing gamma-prime stability, while principal component analysis confirmed that the proposed alloys occupy chemically relevant descriptor regions. This physics-informed inverse design framework provides an efficient route for identifying high-performance Co-based superalloys and can be adapted to other advanced structural alloys.

AI.tldr: 本文提出物理信息机器学习框架，用于Co基高温合金的逆向设计，在考虑合金密度的同时提升γ'相溶解温度。
AI.motivation: 下一代Co基高温合金的设计空间庞大，且合金元素间相互作用复杂，难以高效发现具有更高高温稳定性的成分。
AI.method: 采用4个物理描述符（原子尺寸失配δ-MV、混合焓Δ-Hm、电负性失配δ-EN、价电子浓度失配δ-VEC）表征相稳定性；用留一交叉验证评估回归算法，GPR表现最佳；结合GPR不确定性进行贝叶斯优化，并用NSGA-II和遗传算法同时优化γ'溶解温度与密度。
AI.result: GPR达到R²=0.932、RMSE=34.7°C、MAE=25.9°C；优化生成大量未探索成分，预测γ'溶解温度为1248–1353°C，部分接近或超过实验数据最大值。
AI.conclusion: 原子尺寸失配和混合焓是控制γ'稳定性的关键因素，PCA验证新合金位于相关描述符区域；该物理信息逆向设计框架可高效发现高性能Co基高温合金，并可推广至其他结构合金。

title: Movable seams in root-of-unity XXZ chains: Relative flux classes and antiunitary spectral pairing
summary: Starting from the cyclic duality tensors introduced by Vernier, Miao, and Yamazaki (VMY), whose endpoint-traced matrix-product operators obey $\mathbb Z_N$ Tambara--Yamagami fusion and realize topological defect lines of the compactified-boson conformal field theory, we retain the virtual endpoint as an $N$-state dynamical degree of freedom and construct an exactly movable seam in the spin-$\tfrac12$ XXZ chain at $q=\mathrm e^{\mathrm iπM/N}$ with $\gcd(M,N)=1$. The local movement identity holds for any unitary $q$-Weyl pair; in the finite cyclic realization, all output phases are locally gauge equivalent and share the same four seam eigenvalues. On a ring, the output gauge becomes a directed twist on a single bond, while endpoint conjugacy reduces the $2N$ labels to two relative $\mathbb Z_2$ flux classes. An explicit antiunitary symmetry protects the class $η\equiv M-1\pmod 2$: for even $N$ it pairs distinct charge sectors isospectrally, whereas for odd $N$ it fixes one sector and squares to $-I$ there. Hence every many-body energy eigenspace in the protected class has even multiplicity. The source value $η_{\rm VMY}=1-M$ satisfies this condition for every coprime root, whereas the ungauged value $η=0$ does so only for odd $M$. Exact finite-size controls show that the opposite class can contain simple levels, so a global flux invisible to local gauge equivalence distinguishes the two classes spectrally.

AI.tldr: 保留VMY循环对偶张量的虚端点自由度，在XXZ链上构造精确可移动的接缝（seam），并用反幺正对称性刻画其受保护的通量与能谱简并。
AI.motivation: VMY的循环对偶张量经端点求迹后给出Z_N Tambara-Yamagami融合及紧致玻色CFT的拓扑缺陷线；作者希望把被求迹掉的虚端点恢复为N态动力学自由度，从而在自旋-1/2 XXZ链中构造可局域移动的接缝，并理解其量子通量与能谱后果。
AI.method: 取q=e^{iπM/N}、gcd(M,N)=1的XXZ链，保留虚端点为N态自由度，构造接缝。证明局域移动恒等式对任意幺正q-Weyl对成立；在有限循环实现中所有输出相位局域规范等价且共享四个接缝本征值。在环上，输出规范化为单键上的有向twist，端点共轭将2N个标签约化为两个相对的Z_2通量类。用显式反幺正对称分析对称类η≡M-1 (mod 2)。
AI.result: 反幺正对称保护类η≡M-1 (mod 2)：N偶时等谱地配对两个不同电荷扇区；N奇时固定一个扇区且平方为-I。故受保护类中每个多体能级本征空间多重度均为偶。源值η_VMY=1-M对所有互素根都满足条件，而未规范值η=0仅在M为奇数时满足。有限尺寸精确计算显示相反类可含简单能级，因此局域规范不可见的一个全局通量在能谱上区分了两类。
AI.conclusion: 保留虚端点自由度可得到精确可移动接缝；其受保护通量类由反幺正对称保证偶数简并，而未规范类一般不具此性质，说明一个局域规范不可见的全局通量可在能谱上区分两类接缝。

title: Optimal Evasion from a Resetting Searcher
summary: Returning to a familiar location can help a searcher find its target---but how should the target move to avoid being found? We address this question for a resetting Brownian searcher and a mobile target fluctuating around a home location. Keeping the target's typical exploration range fixed, we find that the mean capture time is maximized at an intermediate correlation time: rapid motion promotes encounters, whereas slow motion leaves the target effectively stationary. Between these extremes, persistent excursions away from the searcher's reset point can substantially delay capture. Analytical limiting results explain this optimum, while numerical solutions reveal an approximately linear relation between the maximal mean capture time and the optimal correlation time across many decades. These findings identify temporal correlations as a resource for evasion, allowing a target to prolong survival by changing how it moves rather than where it roams.

AI.tldr: 研究重置布朗搜索者与围绕家位置涨落的移动目标之间的追捕问题，发现平均捕获时间在中间相关时间处达到最大，即目标通过调整运动的时间相关性（而非活动范围）来延长生存时间。
AI.motivation: 探索目标如何避免被搜索者找到。已知返回熟悉位置有助于搜索者找到目标，但目标应如何运动以逃避捕获尚不清楚。作者针对“重置布朗搜索者 vs. 移动目标”这一场景，研究目标运动的什么特征能最大化平均捕获时间。
AI.method: 将搜索者建模为具有重置（resetting）机制的布朗粒子；目标则围绕其“家位置”涨落，并保持典型的探索范围不变，改变其运动的时间相关时间（correlation time）。通过解析极限结果与数值求解相结合，分析平均捕获时间随相关时间的变化。
AI.result: 平均捕获时间在中间相关时间处取得最大值：快速运动促进相遇（缩短捕获时间），慢速运动使目标近似静止（也易被捕获）。在两者之间，目标持续地远离搜索者重置点的“远足”可显著延迟捕获。数值结果显示，最大平均捕获时间与最优相关时间在多个数量级上近似呈线性关系；解析极限结果解释了该最优值。
AI.conclusion: 时间相关性是目标逃避的一种资源：目标可以通过改变“如何运动”而非“在哪里游荡”来延长生存时间。这一发现揭示了运动的时间结构在追逃问题中的关键作用。

title: Cooperative Domain-Wall Dynamics in a Two-Dimensional Quasiclassical Holstein Model
summary: We investigate charge-density-wave (CDW) coarsening in a two-dimensional quasiclassical Holstein model following thermal quenches into the ordered phase. Although the staggered CDW order parameter is nonconserved, domain-wall motion remains constrained by conservation of the microscopic electronic charge. The simulations exhibit apparent growth exponents between $1/4$ and the Allen--Cahn value $1/2$. These apparent exponents are primarily accounted for by the crossover kinetics $\dot{L}=[D(T)/L][1+L_\times^2(T)/L^2]$, where $L_\times(T)$ is a temperature-dependent crossover length. At low temperature, nearly binary occupations require compatible wall segments to rearrange cooperatively, producing the $L(t)\sim t^{1/4}$ limit. Thermal broadening creates partially occupied interfacial sites that permit local curvature-driven motion and restore $L(t)\sim t^{1/2}$ at late times. Fits to the measured growth rate, a dimensionless rate collapse, and a long-time large-system simulation consistently support this crossover picture. These results show that a microscopic conservation law can generate long-lived anomalous coarsening even when the emergent order parameter is nonconserved.

AI.tldr: 研究二维Holstein模型中电荷密度波淬火后的粗化动力学，发现表观生长指数在1/4与1/2之间，由温度依赖的跨渡动力学主导。
AI.motivation: 尽管交错CDW序参量是非守恒的，微观电子电荷守恒仍约束畴壁运动，导致非常规粗化行为，值得揭示其机制。
AI.method: 对二维准经典Holstein模型进行热淬火进入有序相的模拟，测量畴尺度L(t)生长，并用跨渡动力学公式拟合。
AI.result: 观察到表观指数介于1/4与Allen-Cahn值1/2之间；低温趋于L~t^{1/4}，热展宽恢复L~t^{1/2}。拟合、无量纲速率塌缩及长时大系统模拟均支持该跨渡图像。
AI.conclusion: 微观守恒律即使序参量非守恒，也能产生长寿命的反常粗化行为。

title: Detecting a large magneto-optical shift in Py/NiO bilayers
summary: Here, magneto-optical magnetometry measurements on Py/NiO bilayers reveal a pronounced magnetic-field-induced wavelength shift, demonstrating strong magneto-optical coupling in this antiferromagnetic system. A systematic and monotonic spectral shift of up to ~ 400 nm is observed as the applied magnetic field increases, saturating at higher fields. Quantitative analysis shows that the associated magneto-optical energy variation is on the order of 107 eV, comparable to the magnon energy scale in NiO. Owing to the large NiO thickness, the observed effect originates from magnons intrinsic to the antiferromagnetic NiO layer rather than from spin currents injected by the Py underlayer. These results provide direct experimental evidence for magnetic-field control of antiferromagnetic magnon energies via magneto-optical interactions, establishing Py/NiO bilayers as a promising platform for optically probing and manipulating antiferromagnetic spin dynamics.

AI.tldr: Py/NiO双层膜的磁光磁强测量显示磁场诱导的显著波长漂移（最高约400 nm），能量变化量级约10^7 eV，与NiO磁振子能量相当，证明可通过磁光相互作用调控反铁磁磁振子。
AI.motivation: 探索反铁磁体系中磁光耦合效应，寻求光学探测与调控反铁磁自旋动力学的方法，并明确效应来源是NiO本征磁振子还是Py注入的自旋流。
AI.method: 对Py/NiO双层膜进行磁光磁强测量，施加不同磁场并系统记录光谱位移，进行定量能量分析；利用较大的NiO厚度区分本征磁振子与界面自旋流注入效应。
AI.result: 随磁场增大出现单调光谱位移，最大约400 nm并在高场饱和；相应磁光能量变化约10^7 eV，与NiO的磁振子能量尺度可比；效应源于NiO层本征磁振子而非Py注入的自旋流。
AI.conclusion: 为通过磁光相互作用实现磁场控制反铁磁磁振子能量提供了直接实验证据，表明Py/NiO双层膜是光学探测与操控反铁磁自旋动力学的有前景平台。

title: Investigation of Hopping Conduction and Its Impact on the Subthreshold and Transition Region Transport in Oxide Semiconductor Transistors by Magneto-Transport Measurements
summary: In this work, magneto-transport measurements, including Hall effects and magnetoresistance (MR) at various temperatures, are employed to directly probe the electron transport properties in crystalline indium oxide (In2O3) and amorphous indium-zinc oxide (IZO) transistors. For the first time, we develop a subgap density of states (DOS) extraction method based on the MR measurements at low temperature, considering both the interference and orbital shrinkage effects. The sign and magnitude of MR are used as direct evidence to distinguish the dominating transport mechanisms between hopping conduction and free-electron conduction. It is found that crystalline In2O3 exhibits a subgap DOS more than two orders of magnitude lower than that of amorphous IZO, together with a smaller localization radius of hopping sites. As a result, crystalline In2O3 not only enhances the carrier mobility but also significantly reduces the supply voltage (VDD) because of the smaller transition region enabled by the much-suppressed subgap DOS. This study reveals that structural disorder critically influences the device operation in the subthreshold and transition regions of oxide semiconductor transistors.

AI.tldr: 本文利用低温磁输运测量（霍尔效应与磁阻）直接探测晶态In2O3与非晶IZO晶体管的电子输运性质，并首次提出基于磁阻的亚带隙态密度（DOS）提取方法，揭示结构无序对氧化物半导体晶体管亚阈值及过渡区操作的关键影响。
AI.motivation: 氧化物半导体晶体管中亚带隙态密度直接影响器件性能，但缺乏直接、可靠的提取手段，且结构无序（晶态vs非晶）对输运机制与器件操作的影响尚不清晰。
AI.method: 在不同温度下进行霍尔效应与磁阻（MR）测量，直接探测晶态In2O3与非晶IZO晶体管的电子输运；首次提出基于低温磁阻、同时考虑干涉效应与轨道收缩效应的亚带隙DOS提取方法，并以磁阻的符号与大小区分跳跃导电与自由电子导电机制。
AI.result: 晶态In2O3的亚带隙DOS比非晶IZO低两个数量级以上，且跳跃位点局域半径更小；因此晶态In2O3不仅提高载流子迁移率，还因亚带隙DOS被极大抑制而缩小过渡区，显著降低供电电压VDD。
AI.conclusion: 结构无序对氧化物半导体晶体管在亚阈值和过渡区的器件操作具有关键影响，本工作为直接评估亚带隙DOS并提供低功耗器件设计思路提供了新方法。

title: Angular Modulations in Magnetic Torque Induced by Phase Transitions in the Triangular Supersolid $2H$-AgNiO$_2$
summary: Easy-axis frustrated triangular lattice antiferromagnets provide an important playground for stabilising a wide range of exotic magnetic phases. The delafossite $2H$-AgNiO$_2$ offers a unique model system containing a lattice of localised ($S=1$) moments surrounded by a honeycomb of itinerant electrons. Below $T_{\rm N} =19$ K, the system exhibits collinear stripe antiferromagnetic order, whereas applied magnetic fields induce a cascade of transitions which has been proposed to contain a magnetic supersolid phase. In this study, we perform detailed angular and field-dependent torque measurements in static fields of up to 45~T on single crystal samples. The angular dependence of the torque displays a sawtooth-shaped signal close to the first supersolid phase, while near $T_{\rm N}$, an unexpected additional modulation emerges. On the other hand, the field dependence of the torque indicates the presence of four field-induced anomalies which evolve in distinct ways as a function of field orientation. To understand these complex behaviours and assess the role of local moments, we employ mean-field and Monte-Carlo calculations on a minimal spin model and construct comprehensive polar phase diagrams at different temperatures. We find that the angular dependence of the torque can be understood in terms of crossing different phase boundaries by field rotation, and we identify qualitative similarities between the experimental and theoretical polar phase diagrams. Our study highlights $2H$-AgNiO$_2$ as a rich anisotropic system that provides a robust example of how spin supersolid orders can manifest in angle-dependent magnetic torque.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过极低温强磁场力矩测量与平均场/蒙特卡洛计算，研究易轴阻挫三角晶格反铁磁体2H-AgNiO2中的磁相，揭示自旋超固态序在角度依赖力矩中的表现。
AI.motivation: 2H-AgNiO2是一种独特模型体系，具有局域S=1磁矩与巡游电子蜂窝晶格共存，低温下呈现共线条纹反铁磁序，外加磁场可诱导包括磁超固态在内的级联相变，其角度与场依赖行为及局域磁矩的作用尚需澄清。
AI.method: 对单晶样品进行最高45 T静态场下的角度依赖与场依赖力矩测量；同时对最小自旋模型开展平均场和蒙特卡洛计算，构建不同温度下的极坐标相图，并与实验对比。
AI.result: 在第一超固态相附近观察到锯齿状力矩角度信号，近TN处出现意外的额外调制；场依赖显示四个场诱导异常，随场取向演化方式不同。理论相图与实验相图在多个相边界穿越行为上定性一致。
AI.conclusion: 2H-AgNiO2是丰富的各向异性体系，为自旋超固态序如何在角度依赖磁矩中显现提供了稳健范例。

title: Unmodeled states and uncertain action outcomes in agentic scanning tunneling microscopy
summary: In physical experiments, interventions can alter hidden experimental states in ways that cannot be predicted in advance. Autonomous scientific agents must therefore interpret the consequences of their interventions while operating with incomplete knowledge of the experimental state. Here we investigate this problem using scanning tunneling microscopy (STM) tip conditioning, traditionally a human-expert-intensive task governed by inaccessible tip apex conditions and uncertain action outcomes. We introduce quailbot, an agent harness that places the LLM inside the instrument feedback loop by linking physical interventions with experimental readbacks. After a brief apprenticeship with a human expert, frontier LLM agents autonomously completed end-to-end tip conditioning on an STM and passed an independent verification. The contingencies that arose during the experiments further exposed the limits of LLM agentic autonomy when relevant experimental states or dynamics were hidden or unmodeled.
